---
title: "Explore Park Visitation Across the U.S."
subtitle: "Compare monthly National Park Service attendance by state"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
toc: false
---

Choose a month and year to see where visits were recorded across the country.
The selectors combine all matching NPS exports in `monthly_data/`. Hover over a
state for its total visits, reporting units, region, and most-visited park.

```{r}
#| label: state-map-explorer
#| column: page-inset

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(jsonlite)
library(htmltools)

state_lookup <- tibble(
  state_code = c(state.abb, "DC"),
  state = c(state.name, "District of Columbia")
)

monthly_exports <- list.files(
  "monthly_data",
  pattern = "^Query Builder for Public Use Statistics.*\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(monthly_exports) == 0) {
  stop("No NPS monthly export CSV files were found in monthly_data/.")
}

monthly_visits <- monthly_exports |>
  map(\(file) {
    read_csv(
      file,
      col_select = c(ParkName, Region, State, Year, Month, RecreationVisits),
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )
  }) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  transmute(
    park = ParkName,
    region = str_trim(Region),
    state_code = str_to_upper(State),
    year = as.integer(Year),
    month = as.integer(Month),
    visits = parse_number(as.character(RecreationVisits))
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(year), !is.na(month), between(month, 1, 12), !is.na(visits))

monthly_state_data <- monthly_visits |>
  inner_join(state_lookup, by = "state_code") |>
  group_by(year, month, state_code, state) |>
  summarize(
    region = str_c(sort(unique(region[nzchar(region)])), collapse = ", "),
    total_visits = sum(visits),
    n_parks = n_distinct(park),
    top_park = park[which.max(visits)],
    top_park_visits = max(visits),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(year, month, state)

state_map_json <- toJSON(
  monthly_state_data,
  dataframe = "rows",
  auto_unbox = TRUE
)

ui <- HTML(paste0(
'
<div class="row g-3 align-items-end mb-3">
  <div class="col-sm-6 col-md-4">
    <label for="state-map-month" class="form-label fw-semibold" style="color:#1E382B;">Month</label>
    <select id="state-map-month" class="form-select" aria-label="Select month"></select>
  </div>
  <div class="col-sm-6 col-md-4">
    <label for="state-map-year" class="form-label fw-semibold" style="color:#1E382B;">Year</label>
    <select id="state-map-year" class="form-select" aria-label="Select year"></select>
  </div>
  <div class="col-md-4">
    <p id="state-map-coverage" class="mb-2" style="font-size:0.88rem;color:#5A6B60;"></p>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="row g-3 mb-3">
  <div class="col-sm-6 col-xl-3"><div class="h-100" style="background:#F3EFE4;border:1px solid #D5D2C4;border-top:4px solid #2F6B48;border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px;">
    <div style="font-size:0.78rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.05em;font-weight:700;color:#4A5B51;">Busiest State</div>
    <div id="map-busiest-state" style="font-size:1.35rem;font-weight:700;color:#1E382B;margin:2px 0;"></div>
    <div id="map-busiest-detail" style="font-size:0.83rem;color:#4A5B51;"></div>
  </div></div>
  <div class="col-sm-6 col-xl-3"><div class="h-100" style="background:#F3EFE4;border:1px solid #D5D2C4;border-top:4px solid #4A7C82;border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px;">
    <div style="font-size:0.78rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.05em;font-weight:700;color:#4A5B51;">Visits Shown</div>
    <div id="map-total-visits" style="font-size:1.35rem;font-weight:700;color:#1E382B;margin:2px 0;"></div>
    <div style="font-size:0.83rem;color:#4A5B51;">Across states with reported data</div>
  </div></div>
  <div class="col-sm-6 col-xl-3"><div class="h-100" style="background:#F3EFE4;border:1px solid #D5D2C4;border-top:4px solid #C48347;border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px;">
    <div style="font-size:0.78rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.05em;font-weight:700;color:#4A5B51;">Reporting Units</div>
    <div id="map-unit-count" style="font-size:1.35rem;font-weight:700;color:#1E382B;margin:2px 0;"></div>
    <div style="font-size:0.83rem;color:#4A5B51;">Park units reporting visits</div>
  </div></div>
  <div class="col-sm-6 col-xl-3"><div class="h-100" style="background:#F3EFE4;border:1px solid #D5D2C4;border-top:4px solid #A45D57;border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px;">
    <div style="font-size:0.78rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.05em;font-weight:700;color:#4A5B51;">Top Park in Busiest State</div>
    <div id="map-top-park" style="font-size:1.02rem;font-weight:700;color:#1E382B;margin:4px 0 2px;line-height:1.25;overflow-wrap:anywhere;"></div>
    <div id="map-top-park-detail" style="font-size:0.83rem;color:#4A5B51;"></div>
  </div></div>
</div>

<div style="background:#FAF7F0;border:1px solid #D5D2C4;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 16px 8px;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(30,56,43,0.04);">
  <div id="state-choropleth" style="width:100%;height:min(68vh,620px);min-height:430px;" role="img" aria-label="Map of monthly National Park Service recreation visits by state"></div>
  <p style="font-size:0.83rem;color:#5A6B60;margin:0 0 6px 4px;">
    Darker green indicates more recreation visits. This state map includes the 50 states and D.C.; U.S. territories are not shown.
  </p>
</div>

<h2 id="state-ranking-title" class="mt-4">Top States</h2>
<div class="table-responsive" style="background:#FAF7F0;border:1px solid #D5D2C4;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 16px;">
  <table id="state-ranking-table" class="table table-sm table-hover mb-0" style="font-size:0.9rem;color:#223028;">
    <thead><tr style="border-bottom:2px solid #DFDBD0;color:#1E382B;">
      <th scope="col">Rank</th><th scope="col">State</th><th scope="col">Region</th>
      <th scope="col" class="text-end">Recreation Visits</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Units</th>
      <th scope="col">Most-visited Park</th>
    </tr></thead>
    <tbody id="state-ranking-body"></tbody>
  </table>
</div>

<p style="font-size:0.82rem;color:#5A6B60;margin-top:12px;">
  Source: NPS Visitor Use Statistics monthly exports. All matching export files in <code>monthly_data/</code> are combined; states without reported data for the selected period are omitted.
</p>

<script>
(() => {
  const rows = ', state_map_json, ';
  const monthNames = ["", "January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"];
  const monthSelect = document.getElementById("state-map-month");
  const yearSelect = document.getElementById("state-map-year");
  const fmt = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US");

  function setText(id, value) {
    document.getElementById(id).textContent = value;
  }

  function addCell(row, value, className = "") {
    const cell = document.createElement("td");
    cell.textContent = value;
    if (className) cell.className = className;
    row.appendChild(cell);
  }

  function fillYears() {
    const previousYear = yearSelect.value;
    const monthsRows = rows.filter(row => row.month === Number(monthSelect.value));
    const years = [...new Set(monthsRows.map(row => row.year))].sort((a, b) => b - a);
    yearSelect.replaceChildren(...years.map(year => new Option(String(year), String(year))));
    if (years.includes(Number(previousYear))) yearSelect.value = previousYear;
  }

  function renderMap() {
    const month = Number(monthSelect.value);
    const year = Number(yearSelect.value);
    const selected = rows
      .filter(row => row.month === month && row.year === year)
      .sort((a, b) => b.total_visits - a.total_visits);
    if (!selected.length) return;

    const busiest = selected[0];
    const totalVisits = selected.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.total_visits, 0);
    const unitCount = selected.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.n_parks, 0);
    const monthLabel = monthNames[month];

    setText("map-busiest-state", busiest.state);
    setText("map-busiest-detail", `${fmt.format(busiest.total_visits)} visits across ${fmt.format(busiest.n_parks)} units`);
    setText("map-total-visits", fmt.format(totalVisits));
    setText("map-unit-count", fmt.format(unitCount));
    setText("map-top-park", busiest.top_park);
    setText("map-top-park-detail", `${fmt.format(busiest.top_park_visits)} visits in ${busiest.state}`);
    setText("state-ranking-title", `Top States — ${monthLabel} ${year}`);
    setText("state-map-coverage", `${monthLabel} ${year} · ${selected.length} states reporting`);

    const topStates = [...selected].slice(0, 10);
    const tableBody = document.getElementById("state-ranking-body");
    tableBody.replaceChildren(...topStates.map((row, index) => {
      const tr = document.createElement("tr");
      addCell(tr, `#${index + 1}`, "fw-semibold text-muted");
      addCell(tr, row.state, "fw-semibold");
      addCell(tr, row.region, "text-muted");
      addCell(tr, fmt.format(row.total_visits), "text-end");
      addCell(tr, fmt.format(row.n_parks), "text-end");
      addCell(tr, row.top_park);
      return tr;
    }));

    Plotly.react("state-choropleth", [{
      type: "choropleth",
      locationmode: "USA-states",
      locations: selected.map(row => row.state_code),
      z: selected.map(row => row.total_visits),
      text: selected.map(row => row.state),
      customdata: selected.map(row => [row.n_parks, row.top_park, row.top_park_visits, row.region]),
      colorscale: [
        [0, "#F5F0E2"],
        [0.16, "#E6BC72"],
        [0.34, "#D89E44"],
        [0.52, "#B06242"],
        [0.7, "#4E7A7E"],
        [0.86, "#2F6B48"],
        [1, "#163122"]
      ],
      marker: { line: { color: "#FAF7F0", width: 1.2 } },
      hovertemplate:
        "<b>%{text} (%{location})</b><br>" +
        `${monthLabel} ${year} visits: <b>%{z:,.0f}</b><br>` +
        "NPS units: <b>%{customdata[0]}</b><br>" +
        "Top park: <b>%{customdata[1]}</b> (%{customdata[2]:,.0f} visits)<br>" +
        "Region: <b>%{customdata[3]}</b><extra></extra>",
      colorbar: {
        title: { text: "Recreation visits", font: { family: "Georgia, serif", color: "#1E382B", size: 13 } },
        tickformat: "~s",
        tickfont: { color: "#4A5B51", size: 11 }
      }
    }], {
      title: { text: `${monthLabel} ${year} Recreation Visits by State`, x: 0.04, font: { family: "Georgia, serif", color: "#1E382B", size: 18 } },
      geo: {
        scope: "usa",
        projection: { type: "albers usa" },
        showlakes: true,
        lakecolor: "#FAF7F0",
        bgcolor: "#FAF7F0"
      },
      paper_bgcolor: "#FAF7F0",
      plot_bgcolor: "#FAF7F0",
      margin: { t: 55, b: 10, l: 10, r: 10 }
    }, { responsive: true, displaylogo: false });
  }

  const months = [...new Set(rows.map(row => row.month))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  monthSelect.replaceChildren(...months.map(month => new Option(monthNames[month], String(month))));
  fillYears();
  monthSelect.addEventListener("change", () => {
    fillYears();
    renderMap();
  });
  yearSelect.addEventListener("change", renderMap);
  renderMap();
})();
</script>
'
))

attachDependencies(ui, list(plotly:::plotlyMainBundle()))
```
